newsitem.title: UK: Irish jockey Swinburn charged with assault.
newsitem.headline: Irish jockey Swinburn charged with assault.

text.p: Irish jockey Walter Swinburn has been charged with assault and criminal damage following an incident at a restaurant in the English racing town of Newmarket, police said on Monday.
They refused to release any other details before the 35-year-old jockey appears in court on February 27.
Swinburn, who was hailed as a boy wonder when he won his first Derby in 1981, was arrested after the restaurant incident on Friday night and released on police bail.

Swinburn was seriously injured during a race in Hong Kong last year but is now fully recovered. He recently completed a 10-day walk across Ireland in aid of charities in Ireland, England and Hong Kong.
He won his third Derby, England's premier classic race, in 1995.
